generation.prompt_exact:
Use the supplied newly generated MODERN collection sheet as the actual matching reference for materials, scale language, crisp naturalistic pixel clusters and three-quarter garden perspective. Author a NEW production sheet with EXACTLY FOUR distinct isolated complete objects in a strict 2x2 grid. TOP LEFT modern bollard light, TOP RIGHT modern ceramic display pedestal, BOTTOM LEFT rustic woodland hanging lantern, BOTTOM RIGHT desert/xeriscape shielded pathlight. All full objects including small mounting/ground hardware inside central 70 percent of their quadrant, with at least 90 transparent pixels of clearance from every quadrant boundary. No overlap, cropping, labels, text, UI, birds, insects, plants, scene, wall, ground patch or painted background. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouettes and minimal contact shadows; no gradient haze or backdrop.
Art: high-quality detailed naturalistic pixel art, crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, subtle dark pixel contours, rich restrained material texture, consistent three-quarter view with modest top visibility and warm upper-left daylight. No photoreal noise, smooth airbrush, chibi or cartoon. The first TWO pieces belong to the reference's modern minimalist family: matte charcoal steel, pale warm-gray concrete/ceramic, natural cedar where applicable, calm clean utilitarian forms. The other two complete named collection gaps while retaining the same pixel style, perspective and light.
TOP LEFT — MODERN MINIMALIST: short square-section charcoal metal garden bollard light, clean rectangular vertical body on a small pale-gray square concrete foot, a slim recessed lightly frosted glass band under a simple flat overhanging charcoal top cap. Light is UNLIT, neutral glass reflections only, no luminous band, visible emitted rays or aura. Modest subtle metal wear, no logo, wires or plug. Entire base visible.
TOP RIGHT — MODERN MINIMALIST: small modern matte pale-gray CERAMIC DISPLAY PEDESTAL, a simple monolithic slender rounded rectangular column with a small flat slightly wider top and a low unobtrusive foot, very subtle warm-gray glaze texture. A quiet sculptural display plinth, EMPTY solid flat top, not an open planter, chair, fountain, statue or bowl. Match concrete/charcoal reference palette; no objects on top.
BOTTOM LEFT — RUSTIC WOODLAND: compact hanging rustic lantern, weathered cedar rectangular frame with four clear slightly amber-tinted glass panes, small charcoal metal pitched roof, simple metal bail/hanging loop with a short two-link chain. One UNLIT short candle inside, no lit flame or glowing aura. Cedar and charcoal material realism; entire chain/loop, roof and base visible. No wall bracket, host tree or freestanding post. This is distinct from earlier wall/post lanterns.
BOTTOM RIGHT — DESERT/XERISCAPE: low shielded garden pathlight, slim dark bronze/charcoal stem, broad small shallow conical downward-facing metal shade hiding the bulb from above and sides, tiny dark lens below shade, short visible ground stake at bottom. Entire tip to cap visible, no dirt patch. Light is UNLIT with no glow/rays. Warm muted bronze subtly fits clay/gravel xeriscape colors, no solar panel or invented electronics detail.
Exactly these four static flattened props; no repeated frames or motion diagram. Transparent beyond minimal contact shadows.
